st: JFK’s Abandoned Multi-Million Mansion Found Hidden Secret Room
d: Exploring an abandoned 1910 Spanish Revival mansion with dark secrets, marble staircases, hidden rooms, and rumored ties to JFK and mysterious societies.

st: The biggest military underground airport in Europe, Zeljava air base
d: Exploring abandoned military sites in Croatia, including Zeljava Air Base, once Europes largest underground airport, destroyed in the 1990s and now dangerous and deserted.

st: The Abandoned Casino Ghost Ship (Money still inside) Stuck in Florida's Sea
d: The Blue Horizon casino ship sailed off Florida to bypass gambling laws. Now abandoned in Green Cove Springs, its history includes a mafia murder.

st: Abandoned Volkswagens Hidden in a Mine
d: Exploring mine tunnels in Switzerland to find hidden vintage Volkswagens, including Beetles, Golf Mk1 and Mk2, Polo, Passat and other classic models.

st: Exploring an Abandoned Ghost City on a Volcanic Island
d: Steve explores Montserrat’s abandoned ghost city of Plymouth, uncovering volcanic ruins, frozen streets, and the haunting aftermath of one of the Caribbean’s worst disasters.

st: The Mall That Swallowed Everything
d: Deep in Fukushima's red zone, explorers discover an untouched high-end tuxedo shop and jewelry store, finding hundreds of abandoned suits worth £500, £1000 each, watches, and gems left behind since the 2011 disaster.

st: The Tunnel Beneath the Castle
d: Carved beneath Dover's White Cliffs, tunnels dating to medieval times became WWII command centres where Operation Dynamo was planned. The Cold War-era Fan Bay Deep Shelter housed 200 soldiers. Today these historic passages are open to explore.

st: Abandoned Doctor Strange Mansion
d: Steve explores an abandoned Belgian mansion frozen in time, uncovering a vanished family’s dark past, forgotten art collection, and the mystery left behind.

st: I Found Coco Chanel's Abandoned Secret Love Mansion
d: Explore an abandoned 22-bedroom Scottish Highlands mansion once linked to Coco Chanel, revealing remnants of her life and a fading historic estate.

st: The Dollhouse
d: Explorers visit a uniquely surreal abandoned house whose entire front façade has collapsed, exposing the interior like a doll's house. The adventure takes an unexpected turn when local farmers arrive and start firing a shotgun in the garden.

st: The Abandoned Illuminati Ritual Gathering Hall
d: Steve explores an abandoned 19th-century hall hidden in the Swiss Alps, uncovering eerie tunnels, untouched relics, and secrets buried for over 50 years.

st: Explored China's Abandoned Theme Park
d: Exploring one of the world’s most amazing abandoned theme parks in China, built to rival Disney but abandoned after going bankrupt just a few years later.

st: The Diplomat Hotel
d: Steve explores the abandoned Diplomat Hotel in the Philippines, uncovering its dark history, eerie legends, and why it’s feared as one of the world’s most haunted places.

st: The Abandoned Disney Resort Chased Out By Criminals
d: The Orlando Sun Resort, once a 900-room hotel near Disney World, was abandoned in the mid-2010s after decline, becoming an urban exploration site.

st: Abandoned Japanese Billionaire's Mansion with $1,000,000 Art Collection
d: Exploring an abandoned Japanese mansion filled with marble statues and art, once owned by a billionaire who vanished after legal troubles.

st: Hundreds of old Soviet Military Vehicles Discovered
d: Exploring a massive Cold War military graveyard filled with Soviet helicopters, boats, communication trucks, and electronic warfare equipment.

st: Abandoned JDM Cars of Fukushima
d: In Japan's Fukushima radiation zone, urban explorers document abandoned JDM cars left since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Geiger counter in hand, they discover rare models including an R32 GTR and an Evo VII frozen in time.

st: Exploring an Abandoned 5-star Casino Hotel
d: Exploring an abandoned 5-star casino hotel in Macau, once closed by the government over safety issues and rumored crime, now left as a haunting time capsule.

st: Nintendo's Last Store
d: Inside an abandoned Fukushima house and store, explorers uncover rare Japanese gaming memorabilia and toys untouched since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Rising radiation levels and structural hazards add danger to every step.

st: Big guns found in abandoned WWII bunker
d: Exploring an abandoned Maginot Line bunker in France, part of the worlds second largest fortification, where massive WWII guns still remain.

st: 200 Feet Under
d: Carved beneath Dover's White Cliffs, tunnels dating to medieval times served as WWII command centres where Operation Dynamo was planned. The Fan Bay Deep Shelter housed 200 soldiers. Today, these historic passages are open to explore.

st: My Abandoned Childhood Mall
d: Silver City Galleria was a large Taunton, MA mall with 120 stores and many amenities. It served the region and was demolished in 2021.

st: This Abandoned Mansion Still Had Jewelry Locked Inside
d: Exploring an abandoned property once sold to become a horse preserve, left undeveloped for years, with stories of its former owners adding mystery.

st: The Radiation Ghost Mall inside Japan's Abandoned City (Highly Contaminated)
d: An episode exploring abandoned Fukushima shops left intact and a highly contaminated car graveyard, showing rarely seen, previously undocumented sites.
